Hero.intro: Full-stack developer at Tesla in Berlin with end-to-end project ownership. Previously CS student and software dev at Otto in Hamburg. Former Hanyang University student. I like coding in Rust and Kotlin.

AboutMe.heading: About Me
AboutMe.p1: I am a young software developer with a passion for programming since I was only 10 years old. I learned how to code by writing server-side Minecraft mods in Kotlin and MongoDB for the server <skyCave>SkyCave</skyCave>, where thousands of players have already used what I developed.
AboutMe.p2: Over the past years, I have gained professional experience in TypeScript and React, as well as Java, Kotlin and Rust for backend development. At the moment, I work at <tesla>Tesla</tesla> as a full-stack developer for internal applications.
AboutMe.p3: If you're interested in what I do, feel free to browse my <github>GitHub repositories</github> or my <projects>projects</projects> listed below.

osu-backup.desc: GUI based backupper for the game "osu!". Allows exporting your local player data and importing it conveniently on another machine.

sc-islands.desc: An island system for the Minecraft server SkyCave. Allows creation and management of protected Islands with their own regions, members etc.

sc-jobs.desc: Plugin for the Minecraft Server SkyCave, providing Jobs with different advantages.

mc-gui-api.desc: MC GUI API is an API for creating graphical user interfaces using inventories in minecraft.
